newsitem.title: USA: Patriot American in two hotel deals.
newsitem.headline: Patriot American in two hotel deals.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc said on Tuesday that it had entered two separate hotel purchase agreements valued at nearly $100 million.

Patriot American said it has entered a joint venture with Cleveland-based Snavely Group to buy and manage five hotels with 879 rooms for $60.4 million. Four of the hotels are in Cleveland and one is located in Akron, Ohio, the company said.
In a separate deal, Patriot American will acquire the 385 room Myrtle Beach Hilton Oceanfront Golf Resort in South Carolina for $35 million.
In the joint venture with Snavely, Patriot American said it will invest 90 percent of the purchase price for the five hotels with Snavely, a Cleveland developer, funding the remainder.
Patriot American said it will invest $2 million to complete upgrading of guest rooms and refurbishments of the Myrtle Beach hotel.
